pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   B. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.

2. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

3. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   D. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

6. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.
   B. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.
   D. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

8. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.
   C. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   D. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   C. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

12. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Transport and Communication and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
